provider_receipt.summary: Review rejected unsupported completion. The verification receipt covers the declared `test` check: `cargo test -p arda-core` passed with exit code 0. Most required source files were inspected, and their read-tool output digests correctly authenticate call-output envelopes rather than source bytes. No context_use_receipt was required because no governed capsule supplied one, and the absence of mutating tool calls supports the read-only/no-modification requirement. However, the declared repository-state context source (`git status --short`) was not inspected, so authoritative repository context was not fully recovered. The projection also provides only the execute-output digest and tool trace, not the semantic execution summary, preventing independent confirmation that the recovered context distinguishes implemented capability, configured runtime, and live proof as required.
